info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Utility Billing Autopays-v1-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Autopay Listing API allows businesses to retrieve a list of all existing autopay arrangements for utility billing. This endpoint serves as a vital resource for financial departments and billing teams to manage and oversee autopay accounts effectively. Users can expect to access details regarding each autopay agreement, including frequencies, amounts, and enrolled user accounts. Typical consumers of this API include utility service providers and customer support systems. Empower your organization with streamlined access to autopay data to enhance billing processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve their current autopay settings for billing purposes. It returns details about the autopay configuration, including the billing cycle and payment methods used.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the autopay settings associated with the billing system. Ensure that all required parameters are set correctly to avoid errors during the operation.
